meta.title: Products cannot be added or removed on a live Knockout or Dutch auction
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the existing prepared live Knockout auction without creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the auction configuration.
Navigate to the live auction stage where product modification is attempted.

args.goal: On the live Knockout auction stage, attempt to add a product and attempt to remove a product, then stop when Procol shows the refusal message "Products can't be added or removed in Knockout or Dutch Auction."

steps.note: Perform the buyer-side product modification attempts and verify the screen demonstrates the refusal.

args.text: Products can't be added or removed in Knockout or Dutch Auction.

steps.note: Assert the exact refusal message required by the case.
